This event relies on a pretext of national celebration to justify ignoring safety protocols. By framing the storm as a challenge to be overcome rather than a hazard, the leadership projects a false sense of control over nature.

The Unavoidable Lie: A political speech is more important than the immediate safety of the attendees.
